what: Combined drafter stdout parsing can consume POSTPLAN_* text from the plan preview
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed routing binds POSTPLAN_RC and POSTPLAN_STATUS from the full drafter-fence output, which now includes the external drafter's plan preview before the wrapper-owned postplan rows. A plan that contains a whole-line POSTPLAN_RC=12 or POSTPLAN_STATUS=ok can misroute the operator flow and break the rc 10/12/13 routing contract.
suggested_fix: When updating the Step 2b routing, parse only wrapper-owned machine rows, for example the last whole-line ^POSTPLAN_RC= and ^POSTPLAN_STATUS= rows after DRAFTER_STATUS=succeeded, or write/read a small wrapper result sidecar. Do not grep arbitrary combined stdout.
